query:
SELECT EXISTS (
                   SELECT 1 FROM device_library_holding h
                     JOIN device d ON d.org_id = h.org_id AND d.id = h.device_id
                    WHERE h.org_id = $1 AND h.hash = $2 AND h.device_id <> $3
                      AND d.revoked_at IS NULL
               ) AS "held!"
